violation_type.title: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Crossing Street (26 TAC §746.5605(2))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Crossing Street
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on the information obtained, it was determined a caregiver did not exercise   proper safety precautions when loading a child by agreeing to have the child cross the street   at dismissal

finding_variants.text: Based on the information obtained, it was determined a caregiver did not exercise   proper safety precautions when loading a child by agreeing to have the child cross the street   at dismissal
Based on the information obtained during the investigation, there was enough information to support a child was allowed to walk across the street to pick up a sibling from school
